yieldVsArea.title: Yield vs area
yieldVsArea.formula: Yield = median new-lease rent/㎡ ÷ median sale price/㎡
yieldVsArea.methodology: Effective yield = area median rent/㎡ ÷ this project's listed median price/㎡ — what you'd earn buying at the price you actually pay and renting at area rates. The gap vs area is driven by price positioning: the higher the listed premium, the lower the effective yield at the same rent. An estimate (no rental history at the new price); real rents outperforming the area would raise it. DLD periodic snapshot; registrations lag 4–8 weeks.
yieldVsArea.priceUpDetail: Listed below the area median — lifts effective yield
yieldVsArea.priceDownDetail: Listed above the area median — dilutes effective yield
yieldVsArea.rentFlatDetail: No settled rentals yet — rent assumed at area level; real outperformance lifts it
yieldVsArea.rentUpDetail: Higher new-lease rent/㎡ — smaller units, newer or fitted
yieldVsArea.rentDownDetail: Lower new-lease rent/㎡ — larger units or older stock
yieldVsArea.offplanDetail: No settled rent yet — estimated at area ready-home basis
